title: test-0036-GEN-GLOBAL
passage: Teacher: Today, let's discuss India's role in global organizations. Rohan, do you think the UN General Assembly can force countries to follow all its decisions? Rohan: I think so, because it is the main UN body. Teacher: Actually, no. The General Assembly makes recommendations, but it cannot force a country to obey. Priya, what about the UN Security Council? Priya: I heard India is a permanent member with veto power. Teacher: That is a common mistake; India is not a permanent member of the Security Council. Only five specific countries hold that status. Also, the UN works on many issues like health and education, not just wars. Regarding the G20, it is not just about 20 countries; it includes the European Union and the African Union, making it a group of 21 members. Rohan: Was the 2023 summit held in Mumbai? Teacher: No, the G20 New Delhi 2023 summit was held in our capital. The theme was 'One Earth, One Family, One Future,' which focuses on sustainable development, not just trade. Priya: So, it is not just about money? Teacher: Exactly. It is about global cooperation for a better world. India has been a member of the UN since 1945, long before its recent economic growth.
